description: BE CABLE - Bornes de recharge pour is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BE CABLE (IRVE). Be CABLE provides a network of charging stations for electric vehicles in all CGRs in France. This dataset brings together the list of functional charging stations for electric vehicles in the various municipalities of France. Coverage: BE CABLE (IRVE). The portal shows the English title as "Be CABLE – Charging stations for electric vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is BE CABLE (IRVE). Its keywords include cgr, public, mobilite-electrique, france, irve. The listing shows 2024-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
